forum.title: V3.9.0 Breaks debugger
forum.best_answer_content: I managed to fix this issue by rolling back STM32Cube Debug STLink GDB Server to V1.2.2
forum.content_text:
I've seen the other post, but my issue is different. I'm now getting:

![TheBigCrowk_0-1778728918128.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/208d4885-ec7f-de58-091b-6df3c01e409f.png "TheBigCrowk_0-1778728918128.png")

Rolling back doesn't seem to be fixing this issue, even though nothing about my setup has changed since 2 weeks ago.

I can't even figure out if it's the update causing this issue thanks to this utterly useless update information:

[Spoiler](#) (Highlight to read)

### Breaking Changes

* **Complete architecture redesign**: The tool architecture has been split into three major building blocks with the purpose of creating a flexible, maintainable and updatable platform consisting of the following blocks: **GUI**, **CLI tools** and **STM32 device support**.

Breaking ChangesComplete architecture redesign: The tool architecture has been split into three major building blocks with the purpose of creating a flexible, maintainable and updatable platform consisting of the following blocks: GUI, CLI tools and STM32 device support.

**What** changed?!

How am I supposed to update my 3.8 configs to 3.9?
